description: This file is a shell script containing a series of tests for a git repository, specifically testing behavior related to directory replacements with symbolic links during various git operations such as checkout and merge.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a successful test case with a descriptive label.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Checks that the command is expected to fail.

methods.name: test_path_is_file
methods.description: Checks if the specified path is a file.

methods.name: test_ln_s_add
methods.description: Creates a symbolic link and adds it to git.

methods.name: test_path_is_symlink
methods.description: Checks if the specified path is a symbolic link.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test script.
